page.overview:
What is Unscythe?

The Unscythe is a legendary magical artifact scythe on the plane of Alara that likely originated from Grixis.

The Unscythe is a scythe that appears to be made of bone. It has a skull at the back of its bladed part with its jaw wide open. The top of the blade is shaped like a spine and the middle of the blade has what appears to be a face on it. Its handle is wrapped in white cloth and it has two golden rings notched into it. It appears to turn those it kills into zombies. It has been called the Killer of Kings though how it gained this name or what Kings it killed is not known.
